wallpaper.visual_review_notes: Inspected compressed 589x1280 JPEG of canonical wallpaper. One adult original woman with silver-lavender asymmetric short hair, amber eyes and a confident slight smile. Refined 2D anime face, coherent relaxed folded arms with one visible hand resting on upper arm and other hand occluded. Opaque orange jacket, black shirt and dark blue trousers. Clean electric-blue sky, teal wall and yellow window accents. No visible text, watermark, unwanted people or evident anatomical defects.
